mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_set_id AS ruleSetId, stats_task_id AS statsTaskId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, door_mode AS doorMode, paired_entry_channel AS pairedEntryChannel, paired_exit_channel AS pairedExitChannel, zone_id AS zoneId, campus, floor, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, max_swipes_per_minute AS maxSwipesPerMinute, enabled FROM access_door_rule WHERE enabled = 1

SELECT id, rule_set_id AS ruleSetId, stats_task_id AS statsTaskId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, door_mode AS doorMode, paired_entry_channel AS pairedEntryChannel, paired_exit_channel AS pairedExitChannel, zone_id AS zoneId, campus, floor, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, max_swipes_per_minute AS maxSwipesPerMinute, enabled FROM access_door_rule WHERE enabled = 1 AND (stats_task_id = #{statsTaskId} OR stats_task_id = 0)

SELECT id, rule_set_id AS ruleSetId, stats_task_id AS statsTaskId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, door_mode AS doorMode, paired_entry_channel AS pairedEntryChannel, paired_exit_channel AS pairedExitChannel, zone_id AS zoneId, campus, floor, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, max_swipes_per_minute AS maxSwipesPerMinute, enabled FROM access_door_rule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, rule_set_id AS ruleSetId, stats_task_id AS statsTaskId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, door_mode AS doorMode, paired_entry_channel AS pairedEntryChannel, paired_exit_channel AS pairedExitChannel, zone_id AS zoneId, campus, floor, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, max_swipes_per_minute AS maxSwipesPerMinute, enabled FROM access_door_rule WHERE enabled = 1 AND channel_code = #{channelCode} AND stats_task_id IN #{tid} ORDER BY stats_task_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, rule_set_id AS ruleSetId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, door_mode AS doorMode, paired_entry_channel AS pairedEntryChannel, paired_exit_channel AS pairedExitChannel, zone_id AS zoneId, campus, floor, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, max_swipes_per_minute AS maxSwipesPerMinute, enabled FROM access_door_rule WHERE channel_code = #{channelCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE access_door_rule SET stats_task_id = #{statsTaskId}, channel_name = #{channelName}, door_mode = #{doorMode}, paired_entry_channel = #{pairedEntryChannel}, paired_exit_channel = #{pairedExitChannel}, zone_id = #{zoneId}, campus = #{campus}, floor = #{floor}, debounce_seconds = #{debounceSeconds}, max_swipes_per_minute = #{maxSwipesPerMinute}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
